passive.name: Gathering Fire
passive.text: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

spells.name: Inner Flame
spells.text: Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

spells.name: Focused Resolve
spells.text: Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

spells.name: Inspire
spells.text: Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

spells.name: Mantra
spells.text: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

damage.value: Karma deals burst spirit-energy damage with Inner Flame’s explosion and Mantra’s delayed cataclysm.

archetype.value: Karma is a support who uses shields and utility to help her team.

axis.value: Karma can use Soulflare to zone an area and make enemies hesitate to walk through it.

spikes.at: More points in Inspire, usually by mid-to-late game

spikes.why: Karma can use Mantra to empower an ability without spending a skill point.

mistakes.value: Karma loses value when she fails to hold Focused Resolve’s tether while dodging abilities.
Karma gets less healing from Renewal when she uses it too early instead of timing it around missing health.
Karma loses Focused Resolve’s second hit and root if she lets the tether break.
